timing: Each recorded 10 Hz frame is shown 3 times at 30 fps; final frame held 1 additional second. No omitted or interpolated frames. 1× means simulation time, not GPU wall-clock time.
execution_alignment: Actual decisions apply from start_frame inclusive to end_frame_exclusive. Final frame clamps the last decision. Sigma is the proposed BC-action uncertainty used by that executed decision.
uncertainty_display: Recorded sigma divided by fixed recorded threshold; no smoothing. Null warmup values remain absent.
warmup: Actual mode is planning; gray trace region indicates missing uncertainty context, amber execution band preserves planning.
coverage_display: Recorded instantaneous block/target intersection over target area; not a success-rate estimate.
selection: Illustrative successful rollout selected after reviewing eight initial states; not an aggregate benchmark result.
